title: float arithmetic and explicit int conversion
purpose: Observe the values produced by the operation.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.3: + - * / on two floats produce float; values are exact binary fractions; integral floats print without .0. language owner decision, 21.10.2026 (D-046): different numeric categories interact only after an explicit cast; no implicit promotion, so int operands are converted with float(...).
